ui.title: Put Chat and Embedding in place.
ui.description: Choose your AI services, then assign a model to conversations and smart search.
ui.loadFailed: AI service settings could not be loaded right now. Your saved configuration is safe; please try again.
ui.providerListDescription: Choose a service and manage its connection. Conversations and smart search can use different services.
ui.nameRequired: Enter a service name before saving.
ui.baseUrlInvalid: Enter a complete service address starting with http:// or https://.

ui.keyConfigured: Key saved; leave blank to keep it
ui.routesTitle: Put Chat and Embedding in place
ui.routesHint: Choose a service and model for conversations and smart search separately.
ui.routeIncomplete: A selected service also needs a model name. To leave it unset, clear both fields.
ui.providerSaved: AI service connection saved. You can verify it now.
ui.routesSaved: Model choices saved. Future requests will use the new configuration.
